Great — **CSS Grid** and **Flexbox** are essential tools for modern layout design. Here’s how we’ll break it down for **maximum clarity and fast learning**: --- ## ⚖️ Quick Comparison | Feature | Flexbox | Grid | |-------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------------| | Layout type | 1D (row **OR** column) | 2D (row **AND** column) | | Use when | You need alignment in one direction | You need full control over rows + columns | | Best for | Navbars, cards, buttons | Page layout, galleries, dashboards | --- ## 🧱 FLEXBOX – *One-Dimensional Layout* ### 🔹 How to use it ```css .container { display: flex; } ``` ### 🔹 Flexbox Properties (for Container) | Property | Purpose | |------------------|------------------------------------------| | `display: flex` | Turns an element into a flex container | | `flex-direction` | Row or column layout (`row`, `column`) | | `justify-content`| Main axis alignment (`center`, `space-between`, `flex-end` etc.) | | `align-items` | Cross axis alignment (`center`, `stretch`, etc.) | ### 🔹 Example: Center Items Horizontally & Vertically ```html

``` ```css .container { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; } .box { padding: 20px; background-color: coral; margin: 10px; } ``` --- ## 🧮 GRID – *Two-Dimensional Layout* ### 🔹 How to use it ```css .container { display: grid; } ``` ### 🔹 Grid Properties (for Container) | Property | Purpose | |---------------------|-----------------------------------------------| | `grid-template-columns` | Define columns (e.g. `repeat(3, 1fr)`) | | `grid-template-rows` | Define rows (e.g. `100px 200px`) | | `gap` or `grid-gap` | Add spacing between rows/columns | | `place-items` | Center content both vertically & horizontally | ### 🔹 Example: 3-Column Grid ```html

``` ```css .container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; } .box { background: skyblue; padding: 20px; text-align: center; } ``` --- ## ✅ When to Use What? | Layout Need | Use | |--------------------------|----------| | Aligning buttons | Flexbox | | Responsive navbars | Flexbox | | Card layout | Grid or Flex | | Webpage structure | Grid | | Photo gallery | Grid | --- ## 🎯 Practice Tasks for You 1. **Flexbox Task**: Create a horizontal navbar with items spaced out. 2. **Grid Task**: Create a 2×2 grid of square boxes.
